notes: Test adapter only; the production candidate source is not modified.
baseline.ref_program is used unchanged on the same deterministic float16 CUDA inputs.
candidate.run_kernel receives a NaN-initialized output tensor and must fill it in place.
baseline.flashattn is called with four inputs and returns output, matching out_idx=[4].
Extra-boundary direct tests call candidate.flashattn and then its returned five-tensor kernel.
No cupti dependency; timings use synchronized torch.cuda.Event.
Tensor repr inside acceptance error messages is compacted to bound JSON size; stack traces remain full.

json_suite.speedup_definition: baseline_median_ms_per_call / candidate_median_ms_per_call; values greater than 1 mean the candidate was faster. Only cases where both implementations passed correctness and both timings were measured are included.

extra_suite.baseline_note: The extra-boundary suite does not require baseline PASS because the supplied original has known tail bugs.
